scientific_question: Does frozen biomedical vision-language localization add useful small-lesion SAM proposals before selector and support losses?
supervision: images and binary image-level labels only until all predictions and candidate galleries are frozen

localization_source.text_target: mean tumor prompt embedding minus mean normal prompt embedding
tumor_prompts: A bone radiograph showing a bone tumor.
An x-ray image with a bone neoplasm.
An x-ray image showing an abnormal bone lesion.
normal_prompts: A normal bone radiograph without a tumor.
An x-ray image of healthy bone.
An x-ray image without a bone lesion.
localization_source.local_views: 3x3 square grid; crop side is 0.5 times shorter source-image side
localization_source.local_selection: top 3 by frozen tumor-minus-normal contrast score; stable view-order tie break
localization_source.fusion: pixelwise maximum of projected full view and selected local views
localization_source.known_normal_policy: exact empty map from binary image label

execution_order: Generate and hash all 371 saliency maps without importing or opening annotations
Run the independent saliency manifest auditor
Generate all 371 pseudo-mask predictions and candidate diagnostics from the locked maps
Freeze prediction, prompt-quality and pseudo-mask manifests
Only then load validation GT for CAM/prompt/proposal/selector/support/post-process metrics
Recompute complete-group paired bootstrap against the promoted baseline

promotion_gates.localization_source_to_selector_research: small_lt_1pct unclipped single-proposal oracle delta CI95 lower bound > 0 and overall unclipped oracle mean does not decrease
promotion_gates.direct_train_pseudo_mask_generation: overall final-Dice paired complete-group delta CI95 lower bound > 0 and small_lt_1pct final Dice does not decrease
promotion_gates.interpretation: Passing only the oracle gate authorizes selector/support research, never train pseudo-mask generation

required_reports: saliency foreground IoU, recall and precision
positive point hit rate and negative point rejection
single-proposal oracle before and after support clipping
selected Dice, selection loss and support loss
10000-iteration paired complete-group bootstrap for overall and every subgroup
forbidden: validation GT before predictions and candidate galleries are frozen
validation-derived prompt, tile, threshold or selector tuning
dropping complete misses or changing cohort/metric
